export interface EquipmentClassResponseDto {
  id: number

import { JsonObject } from './equipment.dto';

/**
 * Gateway mirror of canonical equipment response DTO.
 */
export interface EquipmentResponseDto {
  id: number
  code: string
  plant: number
  equipmentLevelId: number
  erpSource: string | null
  sapObjId: number | null
  description: string | null
  descriptionLanguageCode: string | null
  parentEquipmentId: number | null
}

export interface EquipmentWithRelationsResponseDto extends EquipmentResponseDto {
  equipmentLevel?: {
    id: number
    code: string
    description?: string | null
    parentEquipmentLevelId?: number | null
  }
  parentEquipment?: EquipmentResponseDto
  children?: Array<EquipmentResponseDto>
  equipmentClassIds?: Array<number>
  properties?: JsonObject
}

export type JsonPrimitive = string | number | boolean | null;
export type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | Array<JsonValue>;
export interface JsonObject {
  [key: string]: JsonValue
}

export interface Equipment {
  id: number
  code: string
  plant: number
  equipmentLevelId: number
  parentEquipmentId?: number | null
  erpSource?: string | null
  sapObjId?: number | null
  description?: string | null
  descriptionLanguageCode?: string | null
}

export interface EquipmentWithRelations extends Equipment {
  equipmentClassIds?: Array<number>
  properties?: JsonObject
  children?: Array<Equipment>
  parentEquipment?: Equipment
}

export interface ParentOption {
  id: number
  code: string
  plant: number
  equipmentLevelId: number
  description?: string | null
}

export interface CreateEquipmentWithDetailsDto {
  plant?: number
  code: string
  equipmentLevelId: number
  parentEquipmentId?: number
  erpSource?: string | null
  sapObjId?: number | null
  description: string
  classIds?: Array<number>
  classProperties?: Array<{
    equipmentClassId: number
    properties: JsonObject
  }>
  properties?: JsonObject
  propertiesEquipmentClassId?: number
  isPrivilegedRole?: boolean
}

export interface UpdateEquipmentDetailsDto {
  plant?: number
  code?: string
  equipmentLevelId?: number
  parentEquipmentId?: number
  erpSource?: string | null
  sapObjId?: number | null
  description?: string
  classIds?: Array<number>
  classProperties?: Array<{
    equipmentClassId: number
    properties: JsonObject
  }>
  properties?: JsonObject
  propertiesEquipmentClassId?: number
}

/**
 * Gateway mirror of canonical hierarchy response DTOs.
 */
export interface HierarchyNodeResponseDto {
  id: number
  code: string
  description: string | null
  equipmentLevelId: number
  equipmentLevelCode: string
  parentId: number | null
  children?: Array<HierarchyNodeResponseDto>
}

export interface HierarchyDetailsFlatResponseDto {
  id: number
  code: string
  description: string | null
  equipmentLevelId: number
  equipmentLevelCode: string
  hierarchyLevel: number
  parentId: number | null

export interface HierarchyNode {
  id: number
  code: string
  description: string | null
  equipmentLevelId: number
  equipmentLevelCode: string
  parentId: number | null
  children?: Array<HierarchyNode>

export interface HierarchyDetailsFlat {
  id: number
  code: string
  description: string | null
  equipmentLevelId: number
  equipmentLevelCode: string
  hierarchyLevel: number
  parentId: number | null
  parentCode: string | null
}

export interface PaginatedResponseDto<T> {
  items?: Array<T>
  data?: Array<T>
  total?: number
  page?: number
  limit?: number
  meta?: Record<string, unknown>
  [key: string]: unknown
}

export interface PhysicalAssetClassListQueryDto {
  page?: number | string
  limit?: number | string
  search?: string
  sortBy?: string
  sortOrder?: string
  [key: string]: boolean | number | string | undefined
}

export interface PhysicalAssetClass {
  id?: number
  name?: string
  assetLevel?: Record<string, unknown> | null
  parent?: PhysicalAssetClass | null
  children?: Array<PhysicalAssetClass>
  classProperties?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>
  linkedAssets?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>
  [key: string]: unknown
}

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts-alpine AS base

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:lts AS build

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm ci \
    && npm run build

# runtime stage
FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/dist dist/

COPY package.json package-lock.json .npmrc tsconfig.json ./

RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc \
    npm install --omit=dev

USER node

CMD ["npm", "run", "start:prod"]

  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:

    - README.md

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: hry-set-be

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'

  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-dynamic-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      repository: mesx/plant-hierarchy-setup-backend


- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
